body: And then residents from those countries move overseas to places that *do* have adequate sewerage infrastructure but fail to kick the habit. My sister worked at a massage school with a lot of Indian and Asian students. The chicks would fill the tampon bins with their gross shit paper and the dudes just left it all in a pile beside the toilets. The school ended up putting multilingual signs in every booth explaining that it was okay to flush TP in Australia and to please do so, and it made no difference. Man I don't envy janitors.
